validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/DUPLICATE checked and clear. P2603 is Northern Natural Gas's 'Rochester Expansion Project' (a.k.a. Rochester Lateral / Rochester Greenfield Lateral), FERC Docket CP18-534: filed 2018-07-27, authorized 2019-02-21, in-service ~2019-11-01 (request to place into service filed 2019-10-29, EIA Completed Date 2019-12-05). Sourced independently from (1) Northern Natural Gas's own project page (Wayback capture of northernnaturalgas.com/expansionprojects/Pages/NorthernLights2019-Rochester.aspx, 2023-03-21 -- the live URL now times out / no newer Wayback capture exists after 2023-03-21, see CDX check) and (2) EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (28 dated releases, Jan2019 through Aug2026, all agreeing: docket CP18-534, MN, 12.3 mi, 16-in, operator Northern Natural Gas Co). Both independently name the project and state 12.3 miles / 16-inch, exactly matching the sheet. Not a hallucination, not misclassified (it is a FERC Section 7-certificated interstate lateral -> PipelineType=transmission is correct), and not a duplicate of any roster row -- it is a distinct physical facility from its docket-sibling P2578 (Northern Lights 2019 Expansion), which the same FERC filing bundled into ONE docket (CP18-534) as two SEPARATE components built at the same time (NNG's own page: 'The two projects will be built at the same time and Northern combined the two projects in the application'). See cross_row_leads for the P2578 match this confirms.

cross_row_leads.facts: NNG's own 'Northern Lights 2019 / Rochester Expansion' page describes the Northern Lights 2019 component (the OTHER half of the same FERC docket CP18-534, built at the same time as P2603's Rochester component) as: '(1) 9.9 miles of 24-inch-diameter greenfield pipeline; (2) 8.9 miles of branch line and mainline loops/extensions ranging in size from 6-inch- to 36-inch-diameter pipeline; (3) additional compression at Northern's existing Faribault and Owatonna compressor stations; and (4) a new compressor station located near Carver, Minnesota.' 9.9 + 8.9 = 18.8 miles, matching the roster's P2578 len=18.8 exactly, and the 6-to-36-inch range spans the roster's P2578 dia='24, 36' -- confirms P2578 = the Northern Lights 2019 Expansion component of docket CP18-534, a distinct facility from P2603's Rochester component, not a duplicate.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The Rochester Expansion Project is a completed, FERC-authorized (CP18-534) greenfield lateral placed into service in late 2019 (request to place into service filed 2019-10-29, EIA Completed Date 2019-12-05). EIA's Aug 2026 release -- the newest of 28 dated releases checked, dated a year after the sheet's own 2025-09-17 LastUpdated -- still lists it as Completed with no note of abandonment, idling, or ownership change. Northern's own project page (Wayback-captured repeatedly from 2019 through 2023-03-21, then no further capture, likely a site redesign rather than a facility change) consistently listed the project as a current/completed expansion throughout. No FERC filing, PHMSA record, or news item suggesting abandonment or sale was found. Status='operating' stands confirmed.
